policy.generated: Only exported gsl_sf_* scalar functions with a verified *_e(gsl_sf_result*) peer.
policy.manual_or_future: Pointers, buffers, structs, callbacks, complex values and unsupported scalar layouts remain metadata-only until a dedicated safe binding exists.
policy.abi: Primitive mappings target the installed MSYS2 UCRT64/Windows x64 ABI.
